idea-plugin.name: Godot Embed Play
idea-plugin.description:
Play your Godot 4 scenes right inside Rider, IntelliJ IDEA or any other JetBrains IDE. No extra game window: the scene runs in a dockable Play Preview tool window next to your code.

Features

  • Godot Scene run configuration: pick a .tscn, or right-click one and choose Run. Works with your own launcher scripts.
  • Full renderer: Forward+, Vulkan or Metal, compute shaders and all. Godot renders normally and the frames stream into the IDE.
  • Follows the panel: resize or re-dock the tool window and the game viewport follows, honouring your project's stretch settings. Sharp on HiDPI and Retina screens.
  • Hover-based input: point at the game and the mouse and keyboard go to it; move away and your editor has them back. Drag gestures continue outside the panel, and the cursor returns to where you pressed.
  • Windowless on macOS: no stray Godot window, no Dock icon, and a game that captures the mouse can't take over your cursor.
  • ⚠️ Breakpoints (experimental): with the Godot editor's debug server open, breakpoints and stepping work through Rider's GDScript debugger, and the view shows a pause overlay while stopped.

Requirements

  • Godot 4 editor build (tested with 4.7) on your PATH, or its path set in the run configuration.
  • Tested on macOS. Windows and Linux should work but are untested: feedback is very welcome.
  • Windowless mode and the debugger integration are macOS only for now.
